title: Launcher cleanup snapshot records reaped pids without an image name, so a leftover process cannot be attributed
outcome: When the test launcher reaps processes at command exit, its record names each reaped process (image name and, where available, parent and command line) besides the pid, so a reviewer can tell a toolchain helper from a leaked test fixture after the fact.
acceptance: Launcher cleanup snapshot records reaped pids without an image name, so a leftover process cannot be attributed is done
